faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BCW&TD Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BCW&TD Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 1 Superintendent (only for female candidates), 1 Matron (only for female candidates), 1 Cook, 1 Helper, 1 Darwan cum Night Guard, 1 Karmabandhu (Part Time).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for BCW&TD Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form attached with the notice) and send it to Office of the Project Officer-cum-District Welfare Officer, Backward Classes welfare & Tribal Development, Purulia, Collectorate Compound (Near SP Office), PO & Dist. - Purulia, PIN-723101, by by hand in the drop box or by post, to reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) of West Bengal 3 years, PwBD (40% and above) upper age limit relaxable upto 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 15000 for Superintendent (only for female candidates), 9000 for Matron (only for female candidates), 7000 for Cook, 5000 for Helper, 6000 for Darwan cum Night Guard.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Superintendent: Graduate in any discipline; Matron: Madhyamik or equivalent; Cook, Helper, Darwan cum Night Guard, Karmabandhu (Part Time): Class VIII Passed. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Superintendent and Matron posts are only for female candidates. SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/PwBD claim needs a certificate from a competent authority of West Bengal issued on or before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Multiple applications from a candidate for the same post will be rejected. Applications received by any other section/office or after the stipulated date and time will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Superintendent and Matron: Written Examination (MCQ, 100 marks) followed by Interview (25 marks). Cook, Helper, Darwan cum Night Guard, Karmabandhu (Part Time): Interview of 25 marks. Superintendent and Matron: multiple choice written test of 100 marks on Bengali, English, Arithmetic and General Knowledge, 90 minutes. Superintendent and Matron: short-listed candidates in the written exam called for viva-voce of 25 marks.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely temporary and contractual. Contract renewed on yearly basis by the PO-cum-DWO, BCW&TD, Purulia on satisfactory performance.
